from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single paper within the provided collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    cites_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER papers from the provided collection that are referenced in this paper's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated extracted data for the task of citation chain construction."""
    papers: list[Paper]
